description: Stayed at the back. He did not speak.
name: Arthur Meeks

description: Set the breath, the third, and the count of mornings.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Reported the trick, and told Sam to stand still.
name: Nick Sorrell

description: Was told to be still, and said he could.
name: Sam Latchet

description: Read the two titles, and left.
name: William Shakespeare
